title: Universal method to determine acidic licit and illicit drugs and personal care products in water by liquid chromatography quadrupole time-of-flight
author: Andrés-Costa, Carmona, et al.

steps.title: Vacuum filter water sample
steps.instruction: Filter 250 mL of water through a 0.45 µm glass‑fiber filter (90 mm diameter, Advantec) placed in a Büchner funnel over a 250 mL Kitasato flask, applying 400 mbar h⁻¹ Pa⁻¹ vacuum to remove solids before SPE.

steps.title: Install SPE cartridges
steps.instruction: Insert Phenomenex Strata‑X 33 µm polymeric reversed‑phase cartridges (200 mg/6 mL) into a 12‑port Supelco Visiprep 57030‑U vacuum manifold (Sigma‑Aldrich).

steps.title: Condition SPE cartridges
steps.instruction: Condition each cartridge sequentially with 6 mL methanol followed by 6 mL Milli‑Q water, maintaining 400 mbar h⁻¹ Pa⁻¹ vacuum throughout.

substeps.instruction: Pass 6 mL methanol through the cartridge under vacuum.
Pass 6 mL Milli‑Q water through the cartridge under vacuum.

steps.title: Load sample onto cartridges
steps.instruction: Pass the filtered 250 mL sample through the conditioned cartridges at a flow rate of 10 mL min⁻¹ under the same vacuum.

steps.title: Wash SPE cartridges
steps.instruction: Wash each cartridge with 6 mL Milli‑Q water under vacuum.

steps.title: Dry SPE cartridges
steps.instruction: Dry the cartridges under vacuum for 15 min.

steps.title: Elute analytes from cartridges
steps.instruction: Elute analytes into a 15 mL Falcon tube (VWR) by first adding 6 mL methanol, then 3 mL methanol–dichloromethane (1:1 v/v) using gravity flow.

substeps.instruction: Add 6 mL methanol and allow it to flow through the cartridge.
Add 3 mL methanol–dichloromethane (1:1 v/v) and allow it to flow through the cartridge.

steps.title: Evaporate eluate to dryness
steps.instruction: Evaporate the combined eluate to dryness at 40 °C using a Stuart SBHCONC/1 combined sample concentrator together with a SBH130D/3 heating plate.

steps.title: Reconstitute and transfer extract
steps.instruction: Redissolve the dried residue in 1 mL water‑methanol (70:30 v/v) by agitation and ultrasonication for 1 min, then transfer the solution to 2 mL amber vials with 99 mm Sil/PTFE septa (Análisis Vínicos S.L.).
